purpose: prospective scheduling validation; v2 artifacts remain immutable
primary_claim: A constraint-aware planner can produce valid schedules under shared-device, operator, transport, release and sample-window constraints; standard SGS provides an independent parallel scheduling comparator.
test_split: v2 heldout workloads; this is a retrospectively extended analysis of an existing computational test stream, prospectively frozen here before v3 runs
budget_curve_cases: all 20 common-subset cases are run independently at each of 2, 10 and 60 s; a 60-s run is not imputed from a shorter run

budget_policy.truth_escalation: For the 60-case status table, run 2 s first and extend only cases still unresolved to 10 s and then 60 s. The separate 20-case budget curve runs every case at all three budgets.
budget_policy.rule: A solver timeout or UNKNOWN is never reclassified as infeasible.

sgs.family: Kolisch serial and parallel resource-constrained project scheduling schemes
sgs.selection: Select one fixed rule on the six development cases using valid-plan rate, then mean makespan among valid plans, with input_order as deterministic tie-break. Freeze before test execution.
sgs.lookahead: A bounded forward-check for immediate maximum-wait children is enabled to avoid dispatching a predecessor that has no legal successor slot; this is an explicit extension to the Kolisch SGS skeleton and is reported separately from the original scheme.

ks4000_outage.policy: known outage before an unstarted KS4000 incubate step; replan only unstarted steps and preserve all rows completed by now
ks4000_outage.selection: up to 20 common-subset cases with a valid baseline containing KS4000 incubate; choose earliest eligible case IDs without using post-outage results
ks4000_outage.interpretation: This is bounded digital rescheduling under a known calendar outage, not automatic recovery from an active hardware failure.

reader_reference.interpretation: The v2 reader-outage result is retained as a negative/zero-delay reference; v3 does not overwrite it.

execution.reason: The planners are deterministic under a fixed catalog and seed; this extension measures budget/status sensitivity, not stochastic variance.
execution.wall_clock_note: Wall time is recorded and may overlap native rendering on the host; it is not treated as a hardware throughput measurement.
